title: Sanity Checks for Attention Surgery: Null Models and Matched Interventions for Representation-Motivated Design
abstract: arXiv:2611.13543v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Transformer architectural modifications frequently measure a statistic on internal representations, observe that it is large, remove it architecturally, and report an improvement. Interpreting that sequence requires evaluating whether the statistic exceeds its noise floor, whether it survives a geometric null, and whether the training gain requires the specific direction removed. We formulate these requirements as three reusable checks and apply them to self-attention removal, which deletes the component of an attention head's output aligned with its own value vector. Across nine multi-head pretrained models (5,408 heads, 124M to 6.9B parameters), an earlier-position causal null accounts for 48% to 63% of the head-value cosine alignment, with no monotone scale trend. Under grouped-query attention, this alignment is specific to each head's own key-value group and reverses across groups (+0.24 to +0.27 within-group, -0.11 to -0.19 across

translated_title: 注意力手术的合理性检查：面向表征驱动设计的零模型与匹配干预
translated_abstract: Transformer架构修改通常的做法是：在内部表征上测量某个统计量，观察到它数值很大，于是从架构上将其移除，并报告性能提升。要解释这一过程，需要评估三个问题：该统计量是否超过了噪声底线、它能否在几何零假设下依然成立、以及训练收益是否确实依赖于被移除的那个特定方向。我们将这些要求形式化为三个可复用的检查，并将其应用于“自注意力移除”方法——即删除注意力头输出中与其自身值向量对齐的分量。在九个多头预训练模型（共5,408个注意力头，参数量从1.24亿到69亿）上的实验表明，较早位置的因果零模型可以解释头-值余弦对齐的48%到63%，且不存在随规模单调变化的趋势。在分组查询注意力下，这种对齐是每个头所属键值组特有的，并在不同组之间发生反转（组内为+0.24至+0.27，组间为-0.11至-0.19……）
tldr: 该论文提出三个可复用的合理性检查（噪声底线、几何零模型、匹配干预）来严格检验基于表征统计的架构修改，并发现自注意力移除中的头-值对齐很大程度上可由早期位置的因果零模型解释，而非模型真正依赖的特定表征方向。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes three reusable sanity checks for representation-motivated architectural modifications and shows that the head-value alignment exploited by self-attention removal is largely explained by an earlier-position causal null rather than a direction the model genuinely relies on.
